basic_info.description: Great price on this conveniently located spacious full-size one bedroom condo with private balcony at Opera Plaza. Spacious floor plan with dining area. Excellent closet space. New stainless kitchen appliances. Opera Plaza is a high amenities building with 24 hour security personnel, heated pool and spa, fitness center, Pickleball and racquetball court, on-site management, concierge service and more. Best central San Francisco location is close to transportation and freeways. Adjacent to Hayes Valley and Valencia Corridor. Leased parking available on site.
